gates.G-LIVE: Restaurant permission, data purposes and accountable operational lead
gates.G-DATA: Authorized examples, selected coverage and relevant source mapping/opening facts
gates.G-PMS: Actual activities, validated procedures, sources and competent applicability determination
gates.G-DEVICE: Supported actual devices, capture/network and bounded offline behavior
gates.G-PRIVACY: Scoped evidence, purpose-specific retention, investigation holds and device-loss policy
gates.G-STOCK: Unknown/negative stock, conversion and physical-use exception policy
gates.G-ARCH: Initial topology, data ownership, identity and external-contract ADRs
gates.G-OPS: Agreed recovery/performance budgets, monitoring and rehearsed restore
gates.G-PILOT: Agreed baseline, observation period/resources and review criteria

E00.title: Discovery, decisions and pilot preparation
E00.outcome: Resolve material unknowns without reopening approved product decisions.

E01.title: Architecture and platform foundation
E01.outcome: Create explicit domain boundaries and consistent transactional contracts.

E02.title: Identity, tenant/site isolation and permissions
E02.outcome: Every operational action has the correct individual, scope and authority.

E03.title: Product catalogue and Open Food Facts
E03.outcome: Identify real products and keep external references distinct from delivery facts.

E04.title: Receiving and label evidence
E04.outcome: Accept eligible goods once with short, traceable receiving checks.

E05.title: Inventory ledger, transfers and physical checks
E05.outcome: Maintain explainable batch balances without claiming theoretical use is measured.

E06.title: Recipes, intermediate preparations and nutrition
E06.outcome: Maintain reviewed, versioned recipes linked to actual products and calculation bases.

E07.title: Capacity, weekly menu planning and publication
E07.outcome: Plan feasible services and publish matching approved information.

E08.title: Production execution and adaptations
E08.outcome: Record actual preparation batches and changes before serving.

E09.title: Food safety procedures, controls and incidents
E09.outcome: Support every applicable local safety workflow and preserve evidence/gaps.

E10.title: Closing, leftovers, eligible reuse and labels
E10.outcome: Distinguish remaining food, disposal and authorized prepared stock.

E11.title: Innovorder imports and assisted forecasting
E11.outcome: Build comparable dish history and explainable quantity recommendations.

E12.title: Stock-aware AI assistance and evaluation
E12.outcome: Provide useful chef-controlled suggestions with bounded tools and provenance.

E13.title: Offline continuity and shared-device recovery
E13.outcome: Preserve individual observations through network and device changes.

E14.title: Tasks, alerts, reporting and pilot economics
E14.outcome: Make follow-up actionable and measure value with explicit coverage.

E15.title: Operational UX and screen integration
E15.outcome: Deliver a usable phone/tablet journey with task-oriented navigation.

E16.title: Verification, operations and live-pilot release
E16.outcome: Demonstrate critical invariants, recovery and actual operator readiness.

E17.title: Deferred product and integration evolution
E17.outcome: Preserve the broader vision without making it an MVP dependency.

items.title: Obtain pilot permission and establish data authority
items.outcome: use restaurant operations and data only within an explicit agreed scope
acceptance: Record the authorizing organization/person, site, allowed purposes and data access
Separate founder access from actual restaurant permission; unresolved permission remains visible
Document operator/customer data ownership, exports and operator-change questions without inventing agreement
implementation: Prepare an authorization and data-responsibility record
Confirm pilot lead and allowed sample collection

items.title: Select the representative pilot coverage
items.outcome: start with complete selected recipes and relevant cafeteria products
acceptance: Record selected recipes with every ingredient and selected cafeteria articles; no invented approved count
Mark tracked, partially tracked and outside-coverage data, including shared uses
Identify where opening quantities will be observed and how expansion is reviewed
implementation: Build recipe/product/location coverage manifest
Review kitchen/cafeteria shared stock and off-recipe uses

items.title: Inspect the standardized Excel recipe template
items.outcome: map the actual standard recipe files rather than build a universal importer
acceptance: Obtain an authorized example or explicitly use a synthetic fixture until permission
Record sheet/column layout, generic ingredient wording, units, reference yield and qualitative quantities
Document missing gross/net/loss/nutrition/allergen data as missing, not source-provided
implementation: Profile a real template and prepare fixtures
Approve one documented mapping contract

items.title: Inspect Innovorder sales exports and access conditions
items.outcome: interpret actual sales granularity and correction semantics
acceptance: Record authorized CSV/XLSX columns, units, periods, stable identifiers if present and dish naming
Verify bundles/options/cancellations and whether totals are already net
Document accessible history and import effort; do not assume sides, API access or diner identities
implementation: Acquire permitted export/cancellation examples
Create reviewed mapping and reconciliation fixtures

items.title: Qualify actual kitchen activities and PMS controls
items.outcome: activate only locally applicable procedures and legally supportable configuration
acceptance: Record local/central/satellite activities, beverage handling, external dispatch and special processes as known/unknown/not applicable
Review actual paper forms, limits, monitoring method/frequency, corrective actions and competent validation
Preserve source/version and outstanding legal-consolidation checks; no automatic simplified profile or generic temperatures
implementation: Conduct activity and PMS review with restaurant lead
Produce applicable-control and transition-coverage register

items.title: Define responsibilities, substitution and urgent fallbacks
items.outcome: make operational authority and contingencies explicit
acceptance: Confirm chef/director substitution and designate the additional eligible-reuse responsible person without assuming they are the same
Define observation/review ownership, incident contacts and alternative public-information procedure
Document what small ingredient adaptation means operationally without waiving pre-service review
implementation: Write site capability/delegation matrix
Review safety emergency and display-failure procedures

items.title: Evaluate actual phones, tablets, scanners and signal gaps
items.outcome: design capture and recovery for real devices
acceptance: Record operating systems, browsers, camera/scanner permissions, shared-device use and weak-signal areas
Agree supported offline duration/preloads and device-loss/unsent-evidence handling
Do not equate infrared description with a connected thermometer or confirmed display protocol
implementation: Run device/work-area capability survey
Write compatibility and offline acceptance matrix

items.title: Define pilot baseline, targets and evaluation period
items.outcome: judge adoption and economics against a credible initial baseline
acceptance: Agree observation scope, period and responsible roles without invented numeric targets
Measure total new and existing work, not menu time in isolation
Separate estimate/measurement, retained surplus/disposal, forecasting usefulness and causal limitations
implementation: Draft pilot measurement plan and data dictionary
Agree success/review and stop/escalation conditions

items.title: Resolve quantity-discrepancy and eligibility policies
items.outcome: record physical truth without hiding deficits or granting unsafe availability
acceptance: Define negative-balance/conflict handling, unknown opening batches/dates and required conversion checks
A rejected normal stock operation must still allow recording an already-occurred physical use as an incident
Agree targeted-count coverage/frequency experimentally, not as an invented fixed rule
implementation: Document ledger exception and unknown-data policies
Review representative stock and conversion examples

items.title: Define retention, privacy and incident holds
items.outcome: retain required evidence without unnecessary personal data
acceptance: Differentiate records/photos/samples, purposes, applicable duties and retention authorities
Document private attachment access, export, deletion and investigation holds
No universal retention duration, employee diagnosis capture or default cross-customer model training is inferred
implementation: Create category-based retention/access matrix
Review lost-device, operator-change and incident-hold cases

items.title: Choose initial technical architecture through ADRs
items.outcome: start construction with justified authority and deployment boundaries
acceptance: Preserve NestJS/GraphQL and microservices direction while deciding initial service granularity
Resolve database authority, monorepo tool, broker/cache roles, attachments, cloud/recovery, API/event contracts and version selection
Record alternatives, transaction/recovery consequences and current documentation to consult at implementation; no live provider is activated
implementation: Write topology/data-ownership and integration ADRs
Define local synthetic-data development slice

items.title: Choose session, offline access and integration contracts
items.outcome: resolve access and external-service behavior before dependent code
acceptance: Select authentication/session/revocation and shared-device switching policy without assuming a PIN decision
Specify OFF and AI licensing/data-use, timeouts, limits and source provenance requirements
Separate selected providers from evaluation candidates; record capability-disable behavior and manual fallback
implementation: Write access/offline and adapter ADRs
Define typed provider-independent ports and validated settings

items.title: Initialize the selected monorepo and local runtime
items.outcome: run a reproducible synthetic-data development environment
acceptance: Chosen workspace/tooling follows the recorded ADR and declares module boundaries
A documented command starts required local services without live credentials
Build/lint/type checks run for initial apps/packages and fail visibly on errors
implementation: Create workspace, apps and domain/shared packages
Add Docker development configuration and onboarding instructions

items.title: Define domain quantities, money, dates and data quality
items.outcome: avoid ambiguous units, time and false precision across modules
acceptance: Quantities store unit/basis/precision and conversion provenance; kg/litre needs a validated factor
Site-local dates and expiry types differ from UTC instants; money keeps currency
Unknown, estimated, measured and imported data states remain distinct through serialization
implementation: Implement shared value objects and validation contracts
Add arithmetic/date/round-trip contract cases

items.title: Implement persistence ownership and versioned migrations
items.outcome: store each authoritative aggregate with explicit consistency
acceptance: Chosen databases follow ownership ADR rather than parallel conflicting authorities
Migrations/schema transitions and development seeds are reproducible
Critical transactions expose conflict outcomes and preserve historical versions
implementation: Implement repository ports/adapters and schema management
Document ownership and rollback/recovery constraints

items.title: Define versioned API and asynchronous contracts
items.outcome: compose screens and integrations through stable business use cases
acceptance: GraphQL/API operations carry typed inputs, authorization context and recoverable domain errors
Events carry event/operation ID, tenant/site, version, actor and correlation
Documents, telemetry and file imports are not forced through unsuitable GraphQL transport
implementation: Define first-slice schemas and event envelopes
Implement contract validation and compatibility examples

items.title: Provide idempotent command and uncertain-result handling
items.outcome: retry critical commands without duplicate effects
acceptance: An operation ID plus actor/scope/action payload distinguishes retry from a genuinely new operation
Same key with incompatible content is rejected, not silently reused
Clients can retrieve outcome after timeout; rejected/processing/completed results remain distinguishable
implementation: Implement operation registry and transactional command boundary
Test response loss after commit and duplicate concurrent submission

items.title: Implement durable event publication and consumer deduplication
items.outcome: propagate committed changes without assumed database-broker atomicity
acceptance: Commit/event publication follows the selected outbox/inbox or equivalent documented strategy
Repeated/out-of-order deliveries cannot duplicate stock or regress domain state
Failed delivery is observable and recoverable with tenant/site context
implementation: Implement selected durable publisher/consumer adapters
Add replay, duplicate and recovery scenarios

items.title: Provide attributable audit history and optimistic version checks
items.outcome: know who changed each version without destructive corrections
acceptance: Store authenticated stable author and name at action time, site, times and relevant old/new values
Author, validator and substituting director are separate identities/events
Concurrent modification rejects stale approval and retains exact reviewed version; account rename/deactivation preserves past attribution
implementation: Implement audit and version-check infrastructure
Expose authorized history retrieval without leaking secrets

items.title: Store private evidence with lifecycle and integrity metadata
items.outcome: retrieve label/procedure evidence securely and reliably
acceptance: Attachments require scoped authorization for upload/read/export and preserve original evidence metadata
Pending/failed upload differs from absent/unreadable evidence; reference exists only for its actual state
Apply validated size/type/storage/retention rules, incident holds and recoverable upload behavior
implementation: Implement evidence port, private storage adapter and metadata
Verify access denial, retry and incomplete-upload cleanup

items.title: Validate configuration and keep secrets server-side
items.outcome: disable incomplete capabilities predictably
acceptance: Required incomplete configuration prevents unsafe capability startup
Secrets and admin/device credentials never appear in client bundles, public URLs or logs
Test adapters are explicit and cannot silently select live providers
implementation: Implement typed configuration and capability health checks
Add redaction and invalid-configuration checks

items.title: Create organizations, sites and operating calendar
items.outcome: scope operations and calendars to real sites
acceptance: User membership is explicit by organization/site; changing identifiers does not expand access
Lunch and cafeteria share site stock but keep identifiable contexts
Monday–Friday defaults support explicit holidays/closures/timezone and do not imply every weekday opened
implementation: Implement tenant/site membership and calendar use cases
Add scoped setup UI with unknown fields visible

items.title: Authenticate individuals and revoke sessions
items.outcome: use my own identity on permitted devices
acceptance: Login/session behavior follows the access ADR; no shared kitchen account
Revocation prevents new server operations and does not erase pending authorship
Session expiry and reauthentication are recoverable without silently changing record ownership
implementation: Implement session lifecycle and authorization context
Verify expiry/revocation across operational endpoints

items.title: Enforce tenant/site/capability isolation everywhere
items.outcome: prevent unauthorized data access beyond UI hiding
acceptance: API, search, cache/jobs/events, files and AI retrieval validate explicit scope
A user with two sites cannot access a third by identifier, filter or attachment link
Platform administrator and tenant administrator capabilities are distinct; deny by default
implementation: Implement reusable server policies and scoped query contracts
Add cross-tenant/site negative integration cases

items.title: Configure separate operational capabilities and director substitution
items.outcome: delegate only the established operational rights
acceptance: Separate capture, recipe/menu validation, publication, stock adjustment, receiving disposition and eligible reuse
Chef absence can enable director substitution using own identity/site scope and recorded reason
Additional reuse responsible person is designated explicitly; no mandatory double approval or inferred storekeeper release
implementation: Implement capability assignments and substitution lifecycle
Show active authority and audit grants/revocations

items.title: Grant or deny product-use permissions to individual cooks
items.outcome: control which concrete products each cook may withdraw or use
acceptance: Permission records actual product/presentation, recipient, site/context, granter and time
Catalogue visibility, recipe compatibility, batch eligibility and publishing stay independent
Revocation affects new confirmations without rewriting earlier actual use
implementation: Implement individual grants/revocations and requests
Integrate server permission check with withdrawal use case

items.title: Release assigned-recipe product sets in one confirmation
items.outcome: avoid repetitive grants for a reviewed recipe assignment
acceptance: Modal identifies cook, recipe/version and exact reviewed product set with Yes release / No cancel
Cancel grants nothing; unknown ingredient mappings prevent claiming complete release
Later additions do not widen the old grant, other prior grants are not revoked and changed sets require fresh review
implementation: Implement assignment/product-set snapshot and bulk grant command
Build accessible confirmation/difference UI and audit result

items.title: Identify, lock and switch shared-device operators
items.outcome: switch users without taking ownership of someone else’s work
acceptance: Active person/site is always visible and locking/switching follows selected authentication policy
Pending content stays owned by original author and inaccessible outside granted scope
Logout/revoke handling distinguishes local protection from preservation of unsent records
implementation: Implement session bar and lock/switch flows
Test user A pending record then user B login/logout

items.title: Model generic references, commercial presentations and actual batches
items.outcome: keep recipe, commercial and delivery identities separate
acceptance: Generic ingredient, commercial product/pack, supplier source and received batch have separate identifiers
Barcode is stored as text and never substituted for actual batch/date
Bulk/no-GTIN and reviewed manual local products are supported
implementation: Implement catalogue aggregate/repository and validators
Create distinct-identity seed examples

items.title: Look up product attributes through the OFF adapter
items.outcome: prefill available product information from a barcode
acceptance: Return available identity/pack/ingredients/allergens/traces/nutrition/categories with source/freshness
Missing product, incomplete response, service failure and schema failure are distinguishable
A response does not certify delivery condition or actual expiry; no private stock contribution is sent
implementation: Implement typed OFF lookup/cache/retry boundary under reviewed terms
Add found, missing, partial, timeout and schema-change fixtures

items.title: Review and maintain a local product record
items.outcome: complete identification when external information is absent or wrong
acceptance: Reference-to-package mismatch can be corrected from label/documentation while preserving source
Reviewed fields are not silently overwritten by future OFF updates
Missing allergen/nutrition data remains unknown, not zero or free-from
implementation: Implement editable reference review and fallback capture
Store field-level provenance/review and product versions

items.title: Define checked packaging and quantity conversions
items.outcome: convert delivered packs to compatible operational quantities
acceptance: Nominal pack size and number of packs are distinct; ten 5 kg bags imply 50 kg only after checked conversion
Cases/mass/volume/count relationships require explicit compatible factors
Changing presentation preserves historical conversions and flags invalid downstream mappings
implementation: Implement versioned packaging/unit mapping
Show conversion preview and reject incompatible units

items.title: Preserve source licensing and external update review
items.outcome: reuse permitted external data without corrupting approved references
acceptance: Record applicable OFF data/image attribution/storage policy and provider terms validation
External changes appear as reviewable differences rather than historical overwrites
External recipe/nutrition candidates are not selected automatically or copied beyond licensed limits
implementation: Implement source/version metadata and attribution display
Document allowed cache/import boundaries and source-update workflow

items.title: Open a receipt and scan one product per batch
items.outcome: record deliveries quickly without scanning every identical unit
acceptance: Receipt header captures authorized site/operator/source/document without requiring purchase order
Scan/type identifies product; quantity is manually entered for that batch
Repeated scanning does not silently increment quantity, same-code different batches stay separate and scan alone creates no stock
implementation: Implement receipt draft/line commands
Build touch-first scan and physical-match interface

items.title: Capture receipt label photos with assisted batch/date entry
items.outcome: retain batch evidence once for later reuse
acceptance: Photo is linked to exact receipt/product/batch; original image and capture/record times preserved
Assisted fields are suggestions needing review; failed photo/extraction permits manual actual batch/date
No photo, unreadable photo, upload pending and extraction failure remain separate; no invented evidence
implementation: Implement capture/retake and human-reviewed field proposals through adapter
Support manual fallback and partial evidence states

items.title: Record applicable receiving checks and actual temperature
items.outcome: assess delivered goods using validated local procedures
acceptance: Form is selected from reviewed product/state/stage/site profile, not irreversible OFF category alone
Actual chilled/frozen reading keeps value/unit/method/time/author and instrument when required
Blank/not-applicable/deviation/within-rule differ; expected values never become observations
implementation: Integrate profile-driven observation form
Preserve original rule version and observed readings

items.title: Review accepted, rejected, quarantined and pending quantities
items.outcome: see exactly what enters usable inventory
acceptance: Mutually exclusive dispositions reconcile to actual delivered quantity in compatible unit
Complete accepted subset can be confirmed while remainder remains explicitly unresolved
Required missing control/critical deviation prevents affected usable release and rejected quantities never increase capacity
implementation: Implement receipt line state machine and stock-effect preview
Create partial receipt and invalid-total acceptance cases

items.title: Request chef disposition of problematic received goods
items.outcome: decide affected quantities with evidence and correct authority
acceptance: Storekeeper captures issue; chef or active director substitute decides per local procedure
Affected batch/quantity remains unavailable while pending; stock-adjustment rights alone do not release it
Decision records reason/evidence/author/time; applicable safety prohibitions cannot be overridden
implementation: Connect receiving deviations to incident and disposition cases
Show pending decision and authorized action UI

items.title: Confirm receipts consistently and recover uncertain outcomes
items.outcome: complete a valid receipt once despite retry or timeout
acceptance: Accepted quantity/evidence linkage/ledger entry commit consistently with operation ID
Same confirmation retry creates no extra stock; a new real delivery of the same barcode is allowed
After timeout UI retrieves result; no success on failed persistence and no blanket receipt cancellation after posting
implementation: Implement receipt-to-ledger transaction and result query
Test commit-before-timeout and repeated confirmations

items.title: Correct a confirmed receipt or release quarantined goods
items.outcome: resolve later receipt changes without deleting original facts
acceptance: Draft cancellation posts no stock; confirmed correction uses attributable adjustment/reversal
Quarantine release requires separate eligible decision and affects only remaining relevant quantity
Linked production or concurrent movements are checked; correction cannot silently restore already-used goods
implementation: Implement correction/release commands with version checks
Expose original receipt, differences and resulting restrictions

items.title: Register persistent storage and usage locations
items.outcome: track reserves and kitchen stock within one site
acceptance: Reserve/kitchen locations are distinct but aggregate to the same site quantity
Opening state and applicable conditions remain attached after a move
Location change alone does not consume, release or create product availability
implementation: Implement site-scoped location model
Add location and aggregate balance views

items.title: Record the representative opening physical inventory
items.outcome: establish observed starting balances without invented deliveries
acceptance: Selected products are counted by location/batch where known with observed amount/unit/method/author/time
Unknown batch/date/source is explicitly pending under agreed eligibility policy
Opening movement is identified as inventory, retry-safe and never a fabricated historic receipt
implementation: Implement opening observation/review/import command
Display tracked/partial/untracked coverage

items.title: Implement the batch movement ledger and balance projections
items.outcome: explain every stock balance by attributable events
acceptance: Entries record site/location/product/batch/quantity/unit/basis/time/reason and movement type
Physical/reserved/usable/blocked quantities derive under one documented authority
Confirmed history is not deleted; projections can be reconciled/rebuilt without becoming a competing authority
implementation: Implement transactional ledger and balance readers
Add invariant/rebuild checks for the first movement types

items.title: Transfer whole or partial packs without consumption
items.outcome: move goods into the kitchen while keeping site totals correct
acceptance: Transfer preserves product/batch/date and requires origin/destination/quantity
Moving 5 kg reserve to kitchen preserves 5 kg site total; remainder persists without fictitious daily return
A repeated operation or scan never refills an opened package or duplicates allocation
implementation: Implement transfer use case and preview
Add whole-bag/open-pack/reverse-transfer scenarios

items.title: Manage expiry type, opening and usable-batch rotation
items.outcome: choose a physically confirmed eligible batch near its deadline
acceptance: DLC/DDM and validated opening/preparation deadlines have source/quality and distinct treatment
Suggest nearest eligible deadline for use date, excluding blocked/unknown/insufficient cases appropriately
User confirms actual package batch or another eligible choice; suggestion itself reserves/consumes nothing
implementation: Implement eligibility/rotation service with stable tie-breaker
Build batch choice and unknown-date follow-up

items.title: Protect concurrent stock and allocation mutations
items.outcome: prevent two confirmations spending the same availability
acceptance: Concurrent valid operations are serialized/checked under chosen transaction/version policy
Stale confirmation returns conflict with no hidden partial effect
Previously observed physical deficits remain recordable as incidents, never clamped away or made available
implementation: Implement availability guard and conflict response
Run last-quantity contention and retry cases

items.title: Show inventory quality and partial coverage
items.outcome: know the limitations behind each balance and capacity figure
acceptance: Display last physical check, observation basis, pending operations and relevant opening/blocked states
Untracked product is unknown rather than zero; estimated balance remains estimated after validation
Kitchen/cafeteria shared uses do not duplicate stock or claim full-restaurant coverage
implementation: Implement scoped quality/coverage projection
Add task-oriented stock and batch drilldown

items.title: Prioritize targeted physical checks explainably
items.outcome: focus checks on uncertainty affecting upcoming work
acceptance: Prioritize using dated counts, open packs, divergence, estimated balances and menu shortage impact
Each task states its reason; no uncalibrated probability or automatically classified waste
Manual checks remain possible and an empty queue never certifies all stock accurate
implementation: Implement rule-based prioritization queue
Record coverage, effort and outcomes for pilot review

items.title: Observe physical quantities and confirm traceable adjustments
items.outcome: reconcile stock with actual observations under correct authority
acceptance: Observation records amount/unit/batch/location/method and original observer/time; visual quantity stays estimate
Chef or storekeeper can approve, including same observer/confirmer, without required dual signature
Approval posts one difference; rejection preserves observation, and unknown cause is not automatically waste
implementation: Implement observation/review/adjustment lifecycle
Test estimated 2.6 kg vs observed 2.2 kg produces one minus 0.4 kg difference

items.title: Reconcile counts against concurrent and late movements
items.outcome: avoid overwriting newer stock with an old count
acceptance: Use observation time and intervening movements to compute comparable difference
Unknown batch allocation, pending offline use or unresolvable ordering requires visible review
Resubmission/reclassification never repeats consumption or changes historical author
implementation: Implement reconciliation preview and conflict handling
Add count-before-consumption and late-sync fixtures

items.title: Import standardized Excel recipes as drafts
items.outcome: reuse the restaurant’s existing ingredient/quantity/yield files
acceptance: Compatible files reuse reviewed template mapping and preview source rows before confirmation
Original file/wording/yield/qualitative quantities remain; unknown units/mappings are explicit
Reimport creates no silent duplicates or overwrite of validated versions; imported recipes are not auto-approved
implementation: Implement template-specific parser and import registry
Build preview/error/ingredient-association UI

items.title: Create versioned generic recipe and ingredient drafts
items.outcome: describe recipe ingredients and positive reference yield
acceptance: Keep stable recipe identity distinct from version, generic ingredient and commercial product
Store net raw amount/unit and portion yield, or appropriate preparation yield; missing/zero yield is invalid for full calculation
Source contains no assumed cooking method, brands, allergens or nutrition; optional enrichment remains identified
implementation: Implement recipe/version/draft aggregate and editor
Add required-data and unit/basis validation

items.title: Review generic-ingredient to commercial-product equivalence
items.outcome: calculate from products actually compatible with the recipe
acceptance: Associations check presentation, unit/base, culinary characteristics and validated yields
Similar names do not automatically merge products, raw/cleaned/processed forms or generic identities
One physical product compatible with several references remains one availability; historical execution links survive later mapping edits
implementation: Implement reviewed mapping/version contracts
Show unresolved mappings and affected recipe differences

items.title: Calculate gross requirements from chef loss references
items.outcome: see gross and net raw weights with editable reference loss percentage
acceptance: Net L stays fixed when gross-based loss p changes; gross=L/(1-p/100), finite 0≤p<100
Example 8 kg net at 20% needs 10 kg gross;25% needs approximately 10.667 kg; pre-cleaned equivalent uses net without another cleaning loss
Editing a reference creates versioned audit, recalculates affected drafts and creates no actual disposal or historical movement change
implementation: Implement deterministic loss/yield calculations and validation
Build gross/net/percentage editor with provenance

items.title: Maintain chef numeric references for “to taste” ingredients
items.outcome: estimate stock use and nutrition without removing culinary wording
acceptance: Keep original to-taste/quantity-sufficient text and chef-defined numeric reference/unit per yield
Missing numeric reference is not zero and prevents falsely complete capacity/nutrition totals
Ingredient presence, allergens, actual product/batch and permissions remain even when quantity is unknown
implementation: Implement qualitative-plus-numeric ingredient representation
Add chef-reference review and scaling scenarios

items.title: Submit, correct and validate recipe versions
items.outcome: approve the exact submitted draft while preserving its author
acceptance: Cooks/sous-chef can draft/submit; chef validates or returns correction; chef can author/validate directly
Previous validated version remains identified and stale concurrent review cannot approve changed content
Validation preserves author/validator and does not publish menu, replace past executions or expand cook grants
implementation: Implement draft/in-review/correction/validated lifecycle
Build difference review and impact indicators

items.title: Define intermediate preparations and prevent recipe cycles
items.outcome: reuse sauces and broths with their own yields and versions
acceptance: Intermediate recipe declares kg/litre/unit yield and consuming recipes declare compatible required amounts
Raw/net/ready yield and mass/volume conversions remain separate; missing factors leave incomplete calculation
Reject self-reference and indirect cycles; edits preserve historical batch recipe versions
implementation: Implement recipe-component graph and reference validation
Add multi-level/circular/unit-mismatch cases

items.title: Aggregate reviewed allergens from products and components
items.outcome: review visible allergen information grounded in actual composition
acceptance: Visible block separates declared presence, traces, unknown and provisional product choices
Include sauce/seasoning/intermediate composition; generic names or missing OFF fields never prove absence
Product/version changes flag affected recipes/executions; local cross-contamination is not inferred from OFF
implementation: Implement versioned composition/allergen projection
Build source/evidence and pending-data review blocks

items.title: Normalize nutritional references with explicit basis
items.outcome: use compatible ingredient nutrition without arbitrary brand assumptions
acceptance: Preserve source/version/date/product state, units and 100 g/100 ml/known-portion basis
Missing nutrient is unknown rather than zero; as-sold/prepared and kg/litre are not mixed without valid factors
OFF/local reviewed references are supported; no external nutrition database/API is selected by this task
implementation: Implement nutrition-reference mapping and provenance
Expose partial/incompatible source status for review

items.title: Calculate estimated nutrition per portion and ready-weight basis
items.outcome: see a useful nutritional table without false completeness
acceptance: Show energy kJ/kcal, fat/saturates, carbohydrate/sugars, protein/salt and fibre where supported
Compatible edible quantity×reference nutrients aggregates once through intermediate components and scales by positive yield
Missing final ready mass prevents definitive per 100 g ready totals; chef nominal mass may be explicitly estimated, process limitations remain visible
implementation: Implement versioned nutrient aggregation and completeness checks
Build per-portion/per 100 g table with assumptions and source drilldown

items.title: Define chef portion grams and component percentages
items.outcome: set planning references supported by explicit ready/raw conversions
acceptance: Positive total grams and component percentages total 100% before full-reference validation; do not silently fix sum
500 g at 40/20/40 yields 200/100/200 g; protein preparation mass is not protein nutrient mass
Ready portion/cleaned raw/gross raw stay separate; reference composition does not claim each customer chose it
implementation: Implement reference-portion components and conversion validation
Show gram totals, yield limitations and calculation impacts

items.title: Scale recipe requirements in compatible stock units
items.outcome: derive repeatable ingredient needs from yield and planned portions
acceptance: Use Q×P/R for net raw amounts and validated gross/presentation factors only where necessary
Missing/zero yield or required conversion produces incomplete state, not fabricated capacity
Retain internal precision and separate culinary/batch/whole-unit/purchase rounding assumptions
implementation: Implement deterministic requirement expansion service
Add 10-vs 100 yield, cleaned/raw, cooked/raw and batch fixtures

items.title: Calculate isolated and joint menu capacity
items.outcome: see limiting ingredients without double-counting shared stock
acceptance: Isolated capacity is minimum whole portions across all valid mandatory ingredients; partial input is labelled partial bound
With 5 kg rice at 80 g A and 60 g B, isolated 62 A or 83 B;30 A leaves 43 B,44 B flags 40 g short
All physical product supply constraints are shared across compatible generic references and prepared stock; no double allocation
implementation: Implement joint feasibility engine using unique supply pools
Expose ingredient-level reason and competing allocations

items.title: Plan weekly lunch menus with free category composition
items.outcome: choose any number of starters, mains and desserts
acceptance: Select site/week/date/service and configure/order items without fixed quotas or equal-portion assumptions
Record attendance source/history/company/chef adjustment separately from per-dish quantities
Changes recalculate daily/weekly needs and eligibility for use dates; holidays/closures are not zero-demand observations

items.title: Display pending, synced and review-needed operation states

acceptance: Expose saved-local/waiting/syncing/synced/review-or-error states per operation and attachment
Server acceptance is not chef validation/publication/notification delivery
Session bar shows site/user/connectivity/pending count and supports manual recovery actions
implementation: Implement queue/read-status model and session indicators
Verify uncertain timeout and partially uploaded evidence UI

items.title: Isolate offline data through logout and user switching
items.outcome: share a device without inheriting another operator’s pending content
acceptance: Switching retains original ownership/author; unauthorized operator cannot view or submit as themselves
Local login/offline access follows selected policy, with no assumed PIN-based new identity
Logout/revoke/wipe recovery protects access while preserving unsent evidence through explicit recovery policy
implementation: Implement per-identity queue encryption/access controls per ADR
Test user switch, session expiry, device theft and pending-recovery cases

items.title: Revalidate pending operations on synchronization
items.outcome: apply only still-authorized valid commands while retaining captured facts
acceptance: Server verifies tenant/site/identity/permission/current versions and original operation IDs
Refusal/revocation/conflict preserves evidence and original author for review, not last-write-wins
No offline approval/publication/shared stock claim becomes accepted merely because connectivity returns
implementation: Implement sync endpoint and per-operation validation outcome
Test two devices with stale recipe/grant/stock versions

items.title: Recover duplicate and partial sync without hidden effects
items.outcome: resume safely after connection or app interruption
acceptance: Same operation ID is retried after uncertain response and results are retrieved before new submission
Record/attachment processing recovers independently without duplicate movements/photos
Automatic sending only where technically supported; manual sync remains available and no universal background guarantee
implementation: Implement bounded retry/resume and reconciliation UI
Test commit-then-disconnect, duplicate send and close/reopen

items.title: Resolve late offline observations and version conflicts
items.outcome: review true observations without corrupting current balances
acceptance: Preserve original observation/recipe/batch/author times alongside server receipt time
Show intervening movements/versions and require authorized safe resolution when reconciliation is ambiguous
Resolution uses attributable difference/reversal and does not reassign or delete historical physical facts
implementation: Implement conflict review contracts and authorized resolution
Verify count-after-use ordering, revoked grant and changed recipe scenarios

items.title: Enforce offline decision limits and contingency access
items.outcome: work within clear boundaries during outages
acceptance: Cached approved content is read-only reference; new forecast/external lookup/shared approval requires supported connection
Offline cannot announce menu publication, remote safety release, delivered alert or fresh global stock
Validated emergency/alternative-information guidance remains accessible where prepared; device-loss/low-storage fallback is explicit
implementation: Implement capability availability and warning states
Verify local emergency guidance and manual fallback on real devices

items.title: Manage daily tasks, owners and hygienic waste routines
items.outcome: see actionable work with responsible follow-up
acceptance: Tasks keep site/service/routine/due-time/owner/substitute/context and completion evidence
Hygienic waste area/removal tasks remain distinct from physical food-disposal ledger entries
Overdue/completed/missing and incident status differ; reassignment preserves original history
implementation: Implement routine/event task lists and delegation
Configure actual waste-handling routine and link disposal references

items.title: Create actionable expiry, stock and deviation alerts
items.outcome: notice a relevant problem and the action I can take
acceptance: Alert states fact/source/time/severity/owner and links to permitted batch/control/task
Expiry alerts distinguish DLC/DDM/unknown dates and never release food or invent missing stock
Deduplicate repeated signals while preserving material changes and escalation ownership
implementation: Implement deterministic alert rules and lifecycle
Connect expiry, shortage, missed-control and deviation triggers

items.title: Track notification delivery separately from alert existence
items.outcome: know whether a responsible person was actually notified
acceptance: Created/queued/sent/delivered-or-unverified/failed states reflect actual channel evidence
Failed send keeps alert visible and retry does not duplicate operational commands
Scope content to recipient permissions and do not expose sensitive attachment/health data; no channel/provider selected silently
implementation: Implement notification port and delivery-attempt records
Test channel failure, retry and unauthorized recipient cases

items.title: Provide scoped operational reports and exports
items.outcome: review work with comparable definitions and gaps
acceptance: Reports expose period/site/coverage/freshness/method and estimated-vs-measured/pending-vs-validated states
UI and exports enforce identical access and metric definitions
Unreconciled sales, unknown quantities, incomplete controls and baseline limits stay explicit
implementation: Implement reporting read models and authorized exports
Add source drilldown and missing-data states

items.title: Measure pilot adoption, effort and forecast usefulness
items.outcome: assess whether daily work becomes easier
acceptance: Use agreed baseline and comparable end-to-end task observations including new Apptit entry effort
Useful adoption measures services/tasks/help/chef feedback, not logins alone
Separate declared quantities, physical differences, forecast edits and comparable scope with no invented reduction percentage
implementation: Implement minimal measurement collection and review report
Record qualitative operator feedback and confidence limitations

items.title: Track losses and pilot economic outcomes responsibly
items.outcome: understand losses and economics without false savings claims
acceptance: Waste/meal uses comparable recorded mass and valid meal denominator; missing units/costs prevent definitive totals
Separate expiry loss, observed discarded leftovers, reference cleaning difference and retained surplus
No automatic CO2/saved-meal/causal savings claims; SaaS revenue, services, commissions, GMV and attributable costs remain distinct
implementation: Implement defined loss/economic indicators from available facts
Show baseline/period/coverage and unpriced/unmeasured categories

items.title: Integrate the 12 operational screen contracts
items.outcome: navigate from service task to the correct contextual action
acceptance: Service/planning/stock/monitoring routes filter by capability and show user/site/network/freshness/pending count
All T01–T12 contracts link to functioning use cases when built, not static-button claims
Empty/loading/unknown/permission/error/stale states preserve context and offer permitted recovery
implementation: Implement navigation shell and screen orchestration
Maintain design-to-use-case route/state checklist

items.title: Build accessible touch controls and consistent terminology
items.outcome: operate short forms on phones/tablets under kitchen conditions
acceptance: French UI remains proposal pending language decision; consistent terminology and design tokens do not make English backlog a UI-language change
Touch targets/contrast/labels/errors are legible, state not color-only and camera/OCR have manual alternative
Frequent fields reuse safe references only; no extensive table-only mobile workflow
implementation: Implement shared tokens, forms, confirmations and status components
Verify keyboard/screen-reader basics and real-device legibility

items.title: Design extended PMS, incident and traceability administration
items.outcome: complete workflows that were not drawn in the first 12 wireframes
acceptance: Provide required profile/PMS review, recall/TIAC containment and archive interactions for applicable cases
Common forms vary fields/time/permissions/effects by procedure rather than treat every incident as generic note
Document untested assumptions and role sequence; static HTML is not presented as complete functional UX
implementation: Create contextual form/state designs and navigation links
Review with competent restaurant operator before corresponding live use

items.title: Design recipe, authorization and AI-search screen extensions
items.outcome: use newer approved recipe decisions absent from old wireframes
acceptance: Cover generic-product mapping, gross/net/loss, to-taste references, draft review and intermediate recipes
Include cook product grants, exact-set confirmation and thematic AI search with provenance
Keep proposed UI detail distinguishable from founder-approved behavior and preserve server enforcement
implementation: Design/update recipe and permission/search interactions
Check flows against RF-04.5–RF-04.13 and assignment behavior

items.title: Review end-to-end workflows with actual operators
items.outcome: identify effort and comprehension problems before claiming usability
acceptance: Review receiving/partial acceptance/bag transfer with storekeeper, preparation/changes/signal loss with cook and plan/AI/publication/leftovers with chef
Include director substitution and shared-device handoff under individual identities
Observe errors/total effort and update proposals; no existing browser/usability tests are presumed passed
implementation: Run scripted sessions using complete selected recipes and safe fixtures
Record findings, remediation and unverified scenarios

items.title: Establish meaningful CI and change verification
items.outcome: check contracts/invariants without claiming tests already passed
acceptance: CI runs chosen formatting/type/build checks and meaningful rule/integration tests for changed behavior
Secrets/configuration and dependency handling follow selected architecture; failures block promotion
Test fixtures are synthetic or explicitly permitted and distinguish demonstration from production
implementation: Configure GitHub Actions and test/build commands
Document risk-based verification evidence and release artifact lineage

items.title: Verify stock, recipe and receiving invariants end to end
items.outcome: demonstrate core arithmetic and transactional behavior
acceptance: Cover partial receipt, two batches/quarantine, transfer totals, concurrent last quantity and retry after commit
Verify raw/net/gross/ready conversions, shared rice allocation, intermediate prepared stock and no double consumption
Test missing/unknown data, historical versions and negative/discrepancy policy without replacing physical truth
implementation: Build focused domain/integration fixtures and walkthrough
Record actual outcomes and unresolved failures before release

items.title: Verify offline evidence, authorship and recovery on devices
items.outcome: avoid silent data loss or false confirmation in weak-signal areas
acceptance: Test local-save failure, close/reopen, duplicate retry, partial image upload and commit-timeout
Test user switch/revoked session/lost device/two-device stale versions and original author preservation
No false shared approval/publication/alert-delivery/compliance states; document unsupported browser behavior
implementation: Execute real-device offline/reconnection matrix
Record recovery evidence and limitations for pilot training

items.title: Verify permission, allergen and public-information controls
items.outcome: prevent unauthorized or stale safety-sensitive information
acceptance: Test cross-tenant/site/file/search/AI access, denied product use and exact bulk-grant scope
Changed actual product requires chef pre-service review; rejection preserves fact and public fallback remains required
Test blocked-food restrictions, source gaps, prompt injection and AI tool failures without a safety bypass
implementation: Execute negative authorization and change/publication scenarios
Review evidence against procedure-specific acceptance conditions

items.title: Rehearse backup, restore and evidence retrieval
items.outcome: recover transactional history and private evidence before live data
acceptance: Backups cover authoritative databases, attachment links and necessary configuration with documented retention/access
Restore drill verifies usable balances, recipe/procedure versions, authorship and incident holds
Set/review recovery objectives without invented approved SLA; store drill outcome and unresolved gaps
implementation: Implement backup/restore runbook and rehearsal environment
Test representative receipt-to-preparation trace after restore

items.title: Instrument operational health and define performance budgets
items.outcome: detect failures and size the actual pilot
acceptance: Measure service health, denied access, event/job lag, sync errors, undelivered alerts and AI cost without sensitive payload leakage
Agree common-action latency/availability/load/recovery budgets using actual sites/users/concurrency, not 400 lunches as concurrent users
Alert/runbook covers integration outage and degraded manual modes without representing failure as success
implementation: Add logs/metrics/tracing and health endpoints
Run proportionate load/failure checks and record agreed budgets

items.title: Review live-pilot readiness and operational coverage
items.outcome: start real use only with accountable validated prerequisites
acceptance: Review permission/data authority, selected coverage/opening inventory, actual imports/PMS, roles/contingencies and device support
Every applicable safety activity has tested digital path or explicit operator-accepted transitional coverage; no silent future deferral
Record outstanding hardware choices separately; no code/test result is treated as restaurant authorization or safety certification
implementation: Assemble concrete readiness evidence and unresolved-item report
Record authorized go-live or targeted remediation without inventing sign-off

items.title: Run the pilot and review acceptance evidence
items.outcome: decide next investment from observed use and economic results
acceptance: Collect agreed baseline/comparable service data, operator feedback and all added recording effort
Review estimate/measurement quality, forecasting utility, losses/destinations and incident handling with coverage stated
Prioritize remediation or expansion from evidence without asserting predetermined savings, adoption or causality
implementation: Execute agreed pilot observation/review cadence
Produce accepted findings and next-scope decision record

items.title: Define suspension and disabled-capability continuity
items.outcome: avoid losing critical history when commercial/service state changes
acceptance: Define disabled integration/AI/manual-fallback behavior without silently selecting alternate live provider
Commercial suspension/downgrade preserves history and explicitly handles critical in-progress records
No billing/payment provider or product price is selected by this story; access/data rights follow agreed contract
implementation: Document capability/suspension state transitions and recovery
Verify in-progress record and evidence export behavior

items.title: Evaluate supplier marketplace and commercial offers
items.outcome: preserve future supplier commerce with clear contractual boundaries
acceptance: Define supplier onboarding/offers/prices/tax/minimums/substitutions/returns and responsibility before activation
Clarify attributable commission and negotiated terms; recorded external purchases do not automatically earn commission
No supplier commitment, marketplace price or customer-to-customer sale is inferred
implementation: Conduct supplier and operator discovery
Draft commercial/domain contracts for a later release

items.title: Define purchase-order creation, approval and sending
items.outcome: evolve shortages into explicit commercial commitments later
acceptance: Needs list remains separate from sent orders and recipient contact
Specify approval budgets, exact price/version, reapproval and idempotent send
Do not send a supplier message or assume a selected supplier in MVP
implementation: Design order/approval lifecycle and adapter contract
Plan partial delivery/cancellation/reordering cases

items.title: Extend full order-to-delivery tracking
items.outcome: distinguish supplier/carrier facts through partial deliveries
acceptance: Separate commercial confirmation, dispatch, arrival and checked receipt with source/time
ETA/location/real-time states require actual available source, otherwise identified manual updates
Late events/partial delivery/cancellation preserve outstanding quantities and cannot falsely regress state
implementation: Design supplier/carrier event adapters and timeline
Evaluate access, responsibility and provider costs

items.title: Evaluate invoice matching and financial processes
items.outcome: reconcile documents without rewriting physical receipts
acceptance: Compare ordered/received/invoiced quantities/prices and route differences to reviewed exception
OCR is draft extraction; price difference never silently approves payment
Inventory acceptance does not wait for invoice/payment and Apptit payment role is explicitly agreed
implementation: Model invoice/exception lifecycle and financial boundaries
Evaluate document extraction/contractual integration

items.title: Evaluate inter-site redistribution as a separate flow
items.outcome: avoid conflating surplus redistribution with supplier commerce
acceptance: Assess eligibility/ownership/transport/recipient responsibility and traceability for each proposed flow
Do not turn a catalogue page into cross-customer sales authority
Donation/dispatch profile does not automatically enable marketplace transactions
implementation: Conduct specific operator/legal/process discovery
Draft redistribution contracts and loss/return scenarios

items.title: Evaluate connected instruments and IoT supervision
items.outcome: automate supported observations only after hardware qualification
acceptance: Identify actual sensors/probes, calibration/method/network and observed parameter semantics
Air/device readings never silently substitute food-core temperature
Define offline buffers/source integrity/maintenance/alert delivery without assuming infrared integration
implementation: Assess installation/support/cost and device adapters
Compare validated manual control coverage to proposed automation

items.title: Evaluate automatic Innovorder API synchronization
items.outcome: replace file work only with confirmed access and reconciliation
acceptance: Verify authorized service account/scopes/cost/contracts/rate limits with actual operator/vendor
Support pagination/update checkpoints/cancellation-counterentries and file/manual overlap
Import only necessary aggregated data and preserve idempotency/history; public docs are not enabled access
implementation: Prototype read-only adapter using permitted environment
Specify migration and reconciliation from file imports

items.title: Evaluate more advanced forecasting and additional signals
items.outcome: add complexity only with measured gain and usable inputs
acceptance: Compare candidate ML, attendance/weather or other signals with current chronological baselines
Verify source access/license/availability at prediction time and avoid duplicate attendance adjustments
Record benefit/cost/bias and rollback; no specific weather source, deep model or guaranteed uplift assumed
implementation: Create data-readiness and candidate experiment plan
Review promotion criteria against pilot evidence

items.title: Evaluate tray vision, advanced OCR, SLM and fine-tuning selectively
items.outcome: avoid building advanced AI before task evidence justifies it
acceptance: Treat tray-food estimation and automatic discrepancy detection as separate experiments, not MVP collection obligations
Use permitted datasets and compare accuracy/cost/latency/privacy with deterministic/manual alternatives
No missing measurement is filled as fact and no fine-tuning/shared training is assumed authorized
implementation: Define bounded task datasets/evaluation and consent/data-use needs
Propose only demonstrated useful model/agent enhancements

items.title: Evaluate licensed external recipes and nutritional datasets
items.outcome: enrich discovery without creating unlawful permanent recipe copies
acceptance: Verify provider availability/language/license/cache/storage/attribution and actual recipe yield/nutrition suitability
Distinguish own validated recipe, licensed external reference and AI idea
No provider/dataset, including previously discussed recipe APIs or nutrition references, is selected by mention
implementation: Compare a bounded set of primary-source terms and data examples
Draft adapter/import license constraints for review

items.title: Evaluate NOVYU advertising and public impact communication
items.outcome: extend screens without importing another business model by default
acceptance: Separate approved meal information from advertising/advertiser contracts and unbiased recommendations
Validate collective-catering suitability, programming and commercial terms rather than inherit NOVYU pricing
Public environmental metrics require scope/method/period; no automatic waste-toCO2 or saved-meal claims
implementation: Assess integration/business boundaries and stakeholder interest
Design separate campaign and publication contracts if later approved

items.title: Select and qualify the display player later
items.outcome: complete physical display integration after the deferred hardware decision
acceptance: Record full budget/device/RAM/storage/power/cables/adapters/shipping and real network/screen compatibility
Yodeck remains rejected; no obsolete listing is treated as current complete offer
Validate restart/time/offline/expiry/revocation and actual visibility without third-party signage lock-in
implementation: Identify existing installation and current complete options when selection is reopened
Run actual hardware acceptance against browser display contract

items.title: Select and qualify the small adhesive-label printer later
items.outcome: complete printing with readable labels suited to real bacs
acceptance: Printer/type/dimensions/adhesive are selected only when the deferred decision is reopened
Test legibility/storage conditions/name/dates and any optional code without assuming equipment already available
Reprints never renew date/create stock; offline print/release behavior needs explicit qualification
implementation: Identify actual equipment and compatible print workflow
Run physical label/readability and retry tests

items.title: Qualify additional catering segments and enterprise needs
items.outcome: extend proven core without assuming generic restaurant suitability
acceptance: Assess schools/hospitals/EHPAD/central-satellite/traditional service, clinical diets and their own processes
Evaluate multi-site enterprise/SSO/BI needs and contractual roles from evidence
Do not infer personal health collection, children’s portion rules or existing customer adoption from pilot scope
implementation: Conduct segment-specific discovery and pricing/support analysis
Define separate profile/integration stories only after decisions

items.title: Validate commercial packaging and billing needs
items.outcome: price a sustainable product from costs and willingness to pay
acceptance: Historic 199/499 euro plans and commission examples remain hypotheses
Separate SaaS/service/marketplace/GMV and deployment/support/AI costs
Define trial/suspension/export terms before enabling billing; no payment provider or subscription amount assumed approved
implementation: Conduct pilot willingness-to-pay and cost review
Draft plan/entitlement/billing requirements for later agreement
